_comment: Copy to sites/<host>/softbms.json (git-ignored). protocol: redodo (LiTime/Redodo/Power Queen) or roypow (PowerUrus/Epoch/RoyPow). Use the address type of each pack's connectable adverts. controller: any tunable from controller.TUNABLES, lower-case; raise taper_start_v/taper_end_v if the chargers absorb above 14.2 V.
